profile.summary: Richienb is a mid-level JavaScript developer with deep expertise in utility library development, demonstrated through contributions to Lodash. Their work focuses on core JavaScript features like prototypes, regex (including Unicode support), and functional programming patterns. They exhibit strong skills in testing edge cases (e.g., Unicode emoji handling, JSON serialization) and Lodash’s internal module organization. While their contributions are primarily backend/utility-focused, their familiarity with Lodash’s widespread use suggests practical frontend exposure. Richienb also demonstrates proficiency in Git workflows and open-source collaboration, including handling PR reviews and community-driven prioritization.
